name: Link Toolkit
tagline: Render a URL column as a real link, on a form and in a view.

limitations: Opening a link is a platform call. The demo records that LinkField asked to open a URL but nothing opens — navigation.openUrl is the host's, and the hub's harness is not a Power Apps host.
Keeping an unsaved edit across a form tab switch needs mode.setControlState, which the harness does not persist. The control reports that it could not save rather than pretending it did.

This repository ships two controls — LinkField (field) and LinkColumn (dataset) — in one solution. PCFHub publishes one component per repository, so the demo and the API reference below cover LinkField only. Both are installed by the download.
The demo view is a fixture of twelve rows on a single page. A real view pages, sorts and filters on the server.
